name: openclaw-channel-handoff-ledger-edit-v1

archive.name: openclaw-channel-handoff-ledger-edit-v1.runtime.tar.zst
archive.source: the paper environment openclaw-channel-handoff-ledger-edit-v1 on one paper evaluation host (2026-07-30..08-05); its archived subset is identical by path, size, type and link target on all five evaluation hosts, and pnpm-lock.yaml, baseline/manifest.json, pnpm-store/v11/index.db and baseline/worktree/dist are byte-identical across them
archive.contents: bin/ (node, npm, npx, pnpm wrappers), node-v24.15.0-linux-x64/, lib/node_modules/pnpm (pnpm 11.15.1), pnpm-store/ (the offline frozen store used by Candidate builds), xdg-cache/ (pnpm registry metadata for the lockfile policy check), baseline/ (prewarmed upstream worktree at aef33cfe with hoisted node_modules and dist; Builder dependency mounts and the runtime resolver read it)
archive.excluded: verification/ (9 GB of paper-era verification runs, never mounted), pnpm-home/, cache/, downloads/, npm-cache/, corepack/, xdg-state/, evaluation.lock, and 52 pnpm-store/v11/projects/* links pointing outside the environment (pnpm's store-prune registry of historical development worktrees; dangling here)

used_as: pinned Node/pnpm toolchain, offline pnpm store and prewarmed dependencies for Builder dependency mounts (harbor/builder_dependencies.py), Candidate offline builds (evaluator/candidate_runtime.py, lower_agent/build_sandbox.py) and the lower-agent runtime resolver
notes: Archive-first release: the paper environment was assembled by hand (Node tarball, pnpm, a frozen install and build of the upstream worktree, store and metadata prewarm) and has no package-manager recipe to replay. build-host.sh takes the archive from AGENTSWE_ENV_ARCHIVE_DIR or AGENTSWE_ENV_ARCHIVE_URL, checks the pinned sha256 of the archive and of the content manifest, unpacks it and checks every path against the manifest. A from-source recipe is future work.
